card.name: Partway through rare long words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of rare or foreign long words, such as Lao script, German, Spanish scientific terms, and drug or lab names. It fires on a piece that is not yet the end of the word.

modes.label: Inside long medical or scientific words
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug, chemical or species names that continue in the next piece.
modes.example: in combination with mig<<lust>>at, for patients

modes.label: Foreign or rare words
modes.description: Middle pieces of German, Spanish or phonetic-spelling words.
